records.label: Separate office procurement from low-cost retail
records.details: Staples is strongest as business/procurement/catalog/PunchOut data. Dollarama is strongest as local/marketplace public offer reference plus barcode identity.

records.label: Use official classification and barcode layers
records.details: Use GS1/GPC, GS1 Canada ECCnet, UPC databases and UNSPSC for identity/classification before scraping live retail pages.

records.label: Use Staples business/eProcurement paths
records.details: For serious structured office-supply rows, pursue Staples Business/eProcurement/PunchOut access rather than scraping consumer pages.

records.label: Use marketplace catalog snapshots for Dollarama
records.details: Instacart/Uber Eats expose local Dollarama product listings where available; these are local offer snapshots, not universal catalog records.

records.label: Normalize into offer/evidence rows
records.details: Keep retailer offer rows separate from product identity records, barcode records, procurement records and marketplace-local rows.
